summary: Laurel County, KY lookout in the Daniel Boone National Forest with a radio set and telephone line in 1936; now marked Removed, with no date or site description found.

facts.status_note: Marked Removed on the Forest Lookouts page; no source gives a removal date or describes the site today

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one page quoting a 1936 memo, plus the header lines (county, agency, status label). No build date, design, height, staffing or removal date found; two web searches returned nothing about this tower. The memo names the Cumberland National Forest and the page names the Daniel Boone National Forest; the story reports both without a rename date, which was not verified. Record coordinates and ownership (federal) were not checked against a second source. Access is unknown, so no access fact is recorded.
